description.zh: 查询的结束时间（时间戳）。
description.en: The timestamp that specifies the end of the time range to query.
The ID of the GTM instance whose logs you want to query.

description.zh: 关键字，按照“%Keyword%”模式搜索，不区分大小写。
description.en: The keyword for searching logs, in case-insensitive "%Keyword%" format.
The language used by the user.

description.zh: 当前页数，起始值为**1**，默认为**1**。
description.en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page **1**. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值**100**，默认为**20**。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **20**.

description.zh: 查询的开始时间（时间戳）。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-gtm-logs --lang en --instance-id gtm-cn-xxxxx --keyword test --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --start-timestamp 1363453340000 --end-timestamp 1363453340000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DescribeGtmLogs --region cn-hangzhou --Keyword test --PageSize 20 --InstanceId 'gtm-cn-xxxxx' --PageNumber 1 --StartTimestamp 1363453340000 --Lang en --EndTimestamp 1363453340000
